# Ministry Report Hub

> A private congregation tool for submitting and compiling monthly field
> ministry reports. Publishers report Yes/No participation; regular,
> auxiliary and special pioneers report hours and Bible studies. The
> secretary views a live, exportable roll-up for the congregation.

This application sits behind authentication. Its dashboard and secretary
pages contain private congregation data and are not for indexing or
training use. Only the public marketing, login and registration pages
are open to crawling — see /robots.txt.

## Pages
- /: Overview and sign-up entry point
- /login: Account sign-in
- /register: Account creation
